note: Written by hand from the test runs; each shown finding is held by a strict xfail named in 'test'. Cited findings of sister cards are listed under 'cited' and are not filed again.

findings.claim: A torn last line (a write cut short) is reported as tampering: 'invalid JSON' and 'events dropped, a day file deleted, or the chain rewritten'; nothing names it a write cut short.
findings.expected: D-127: a torn last line is damage the next writer repairs, not an attack; the person reading the check must be told which it is.
findings.happened: tamper.json case torn_last_line: both verifiers fail with invalid JSON and the HEAD.json 'events dropped' message; after the next write the chain verifies (case torn_then_written).

findings.lane: C2 (D for the Makefile target and the runbook)
findings.claim: make audit-verify without ANCHOR (tools/audit_verify.py without --heads) prints PASS on a fully re-chained forgery, a prefix, a fresh chain and a rollback, with no word that no signed head was read: a check that says PASS on a forged trail. The daily runbook names --heads (docs/runbook/02-daily-operation.md:8); the Makefile default (Makefile:434) and the close-out runbook's first command (20-close-out-and-decommissioning.md:39) do not.
findings.expected: D-355: only the signed heads catch a chain rewritten with its HEAD.json; the console says so when no anchor folder is set (audit.verify.no_anchor).
findings.happened: tamper.json: cli_no_heads_ok is PASS for rechained_with_head, prefix_with_head, fresh_chain_from_genesis and rollback_to_backup, exit 0, no note.

findings.claim: The steward's typed reason for a data-ops decision (page and /api/v1) reaches the audit chain in clear: a chart number, a name, a phone and an e-mail typed there are stored as typed, in a store that is never erased.
findings.expected: D-272 (CR-016): no chart number in clear in the audit; writers pass free text through mask_ids/mask_detail.
findings.happened: POST /data-ops/batches/{bid}/decide and POST /api/v1/data/batches/{bid}/decide: the dataops.decide event's detail.reason holds all four planted values (routes.json).

findings.claim: POST /ops/users (add) makes the account before its audit event; with the audit write failing (AuditFull) the account stays, with no event. Reset (app.py:1293), scope (:1308), disable (:1328) and enable (:1332) have the same order by reading (hypothesis).
findings.expected: The 13:30 rule: an audit trail that can be wrong is High; D-273 (DI-5) writes the event inside the change's transaction for marks and opt-outs.
findings.happened: With TB_AUDIT_MIN_FREE_MB set huge: no console.user event, and users.get('atfull') returns the new account.

findings.lane: C2 (console verify, audit_verify, nightly signer); D (runbook, anchor folder placement)
findings.claim: A re-signed forgery passes both verifiers as an operator runs them (actor changed, chain re-made without its head_signed events, HEAD.json rewritten, the anchor folder's heads/ and keys/ emptied, a new key signs). The console trusts the keys it finds in the folder and cannot pin one; audit_verify --heads passes with a note only; the runbook never passes --pubkey (20-close-out-and-decommissioning.md:41, and :65 checks an archive against its own keys). With heads/ emptied, the nightly signer (tools/trialbox/audit_heads.py:113, :127) checks the chain only against its own HEAD.json and signs the forgery with the box's real key.
findings.expected: D-355: a process that can write the audit volume cannot make a signature. To close it: the verifiers trust only a key pinned outside what the same person can write (the box's own audit_sign*.pub, or a key the hospital holds), and the nightly signer compares the folder with the chain's own audit.head_signed events.
findings.happened: tamper.json: resigned_forgery PASS on the CLI with --heads and on the console, FAIL only with --pubkey of the box key; night_signs_forgery: the night returned ok and signed.
findings.ruling: D-562, 'Not done here': 'a person who can delete files in the anchor folder and write the audit volume is not caught; the folder must be one the box's root cannot prune'. Filed because plan 8's High rule asks for more.

findings.claim: With the newest signed head deleted from the anchor folder, the genuine chain passes both verifiers with no word, so the rollback window silently widens to the night before.
findings.expected: The chain's own audit.head_signed events name every head published; one missing from the folder must be said.
findings.happened: tamper.json: newest_head_deleted PASS on the CLI with --heads and on the console.
findings.ruling: D-562, 'Not done here': the comparison of the anchor folder with the chain's own audit.head_signed events is not done. Filed because plan 8's High rule asks for more.

findings.claim: The IRB record's typed reason reaches the audit in clear: a chart number, a name, a phone and an e-mail typed there are stored as typed. team.save_irb also stores before the event (team.py:821, then :824; hypothesis).
findings.expected: D-272 (CR-016): no chart number in clear in the audit.
findings.happened: POST /studies/{rs}/irb: the console.irb event's detail.reason holds all four planted values (routes.json).
